aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile food vehicles: online orders, collection times and fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile food vehicles, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders moving smoothly and waste less time answering repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change this.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started from a simple observation that food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory that helps people discover food trucks visiting their neighbourhood, I spent more time learning the challenges mobile food businesses face. Food trucks differ from ordinary restaurants in that they are always moving, work in many locations and serve customers in conditions that keep changing.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future day or time before the event day.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: See sales broken down by date range, item and event, to see what really sells well.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically; no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Put your logo in your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Enter a buzzer number for the order when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and saying when the food is ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your truck shows on HatchGrab's public map so customers in the area can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming trading days on your own website; each day links straight to the ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with their own prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a real-time kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can make at a time and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can't choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Group items into sets and offer extras at checkout to raise the amount per order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp automatic replies, but for questions via Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens at once, front counter and kitchen, all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login accounts with suitable access rights.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: Turn on offline order protection, then online ordering pauses automatically if the signal drops, so customers can’t place orders you can’t see.
featuresPage.offlineApps: The app on iPhone, iPad and Android helps you keep taking orders even offline, while the web dashboard needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a closing time for items that must be ordered ahead.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don't show on the map, with that event's own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page when scanned.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your trading schedule automatically, from your website or from the picture you already post on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers an SMS automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs and we add the dates, places and times for each week and each event automatically.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Set any item as sold out with one tap; customers see it greyed out straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count and the system counts down as orders come in, and sets it sold out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payment on a supported phone, without a separate card reader.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, helping spread orders across your selling time.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the front of the truck, paid through your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service through the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically reply to WhatsApp questions about your menu and trading schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how many items you can cook at once, and how long it takes. When a collection time slot is full, customers cannot choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the vehicle — and the card reader you already take payments on.
landing.does.lede: Most food ordering systems are designed for shops with a fixed location, stable Wi-Fi and the same opening hours every week. But you move somewhere new every week, at different times, and mobile signal is poor or non-existent. HatchGrab was built for this.
landing.does.offlineBody: Turn on offline order protection, then online ordering pauses automatically if the signal drops, so customers can’t place orders you can’t see.
landing.does.offlineApps: Keep taking orders with the app on iPhone, iPad and Android.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in dates, places and times, ready to share right away — every week or every day.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers pre-order and choose a collection time. Shorter queues, and food ready when customers arrive.
landing.does.slotsTitle: Customers can choose a collection time
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you selling tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp answers customers while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill, using your own menu and trading schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you selling tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will answer customers while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and we will turn it into a really working ordering page for you to try within 60 seconds. Your items, your prices. No sign-up, no card, nothing to install. Have a look first, then decide.
landing.final.title: Want to know how easy setup is?
landing.hero.ctaNote: Upload a photo of your menu and see the system really working within 60 seconds. No signup. No card.
